title: The guest comes in and she stays put
note: The door is CLOSED behind him — he is in, and the entry is over. That is what separates this from the open-door steps either side of it.
scene: Interior entry hall. The guest stands just inside the front door, which is now CLOSED behind him — no gap, no daylight. He has stopped on the doormat a step in, turned toward the handler and looking at her, not at Lucy. The guest wears the medium-blue zip-up hoodie, black baseball cap and clear-framed glasses from his likeness reference. He is NOT in a plaid or checked shirt — that was an earlier version of this character and is being replaced everywhere. His hands are at his sides; he is not reaching toward the dog. Lucy LIES on her cool-grey dog bed — a proper mattress with real thickness, a padded slab about a hand deep with a soft raised edge, not a flat mat across the room, elbows and hips down, head up, watching calmly without getting up. The black leash runs from her collar ring in a slack curve to the handler, who stands beside the bed holding it loosely. Give the leash a thin lighter outline near her coat and keep it off her back.
mustBeTrue: the front door is shut behind the guest with no daylight showing, he is standing just inside it looking at the handler rather than at Lucy, and Lucy is lying down on her bed on a slack leash.
